desc:
⚔️  Catch Verities, level them up, and battle your way to the Cosmic Rift!

  🟡 CATCH the 67 Verities across 6 zones, from the Meadow to the Cosmic Rift
  💪 LEVEL UP your team and watch their strength grow
  👑 BEAT the Guardians to open new zones
  ✨ HUNT rare Gold, BIG and Rainbow Verities
  💰 EARN cash from the Verities on your plot, even while you're away
  ⚔️  DUEL other players for cash
  💻 TRAIN your team at your gaming PC and play Verity Blocks for bonus XP
  🔁 REBIRTH for bigger cash multipliers

  🎁 Use code RELEASE for a free Random Verity!
  👥 Join SMOOF Games for +10% cash and a free Random Verity
  🤝 Invite a friend and you both get a free Random Verity

  👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to get new zones and Verities first!

  🔥 CODES: RELEASE, VERITY
